page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance built on KVM virtualization within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. The system features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity totals 376.0 GB, providing an allocation ratio of 5.88 GB per vCPU. Acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA A10 GPUs delivering a combined 48 GB of GPU video memory.

Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes for all file system persistence and data staging. The substantial memory footprint paired with dual hardware accelerators enables efficient handling of multi-stream visual analytics and intermediate deep learning pipeline stages without frequent host memory swapping.

Workloads best aligned with the ecs.gn7i-c32g1.16xlarge profile include distributed artificial intelligence inference, real-time video processing, cloud workstation graphics, computer vision models, and GPU-driven rendering pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive and graphics-driven workloads. Running on KVM virtualization, it provides 64 dedicated vCPUs using an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system integrates 376.0 GB of system memory, matching roughly 5.88 GB per core, and includes two NVIDIA A10 GPUs with 48 GB of total VRAM. The instance features a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Local storage is not included, requiring external network-attached storage volumes for all data persistence. This hardware configuration is suited for artificial intelligence inference, computer vision processing, digital content rendering, and media transcoding pipelines requiring multi-GPU parallelization.
